name: Jeremias Nyangoen
bio: Jeremias Nyangoen (born 29 June 1968) is an Indonesian actor and screenwriter. Jeremias is known for his role as the Indonesian cannibal character, Sumanto, in the film Kanibal - Sumanto in 2004. In 2024, Jeremias directed Women From Rote Island as his directorial debut. This film succeeded in winning the Citra Cup at the 2023 Indonesian Film Festival.
